mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS event_id,b.kind,b.state,b.created_at,b.sent_at, b.consumed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_message_inbox i WHERE i.event_id=b.id) AS inbox_count FROM tb_business_outbox b JOIN tb_voucher_order o ON o.id=b.aggregate_id AND o.user_id=#{userId} WHERE b.aggregate_id=#{orderId} AND b.kind IN ('ORDER_CREATED','ORDER_PAID','ORDER_CLOSED','ORDER_EXPIRE','SECKILL_FULFILL') ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 30
SELECT * FROM tb_message_failure ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
